css-switch-generator.formula:
height = round(width x 0.55)
knob = height - 8
travel = width - knob - 8
howTo: Set the switch width with the slider, from 40 to 120 pixels.
Pick the color the track shows when the switch is on.
Choose the pill or rounded track shape.
Click the preview switch to test the toggle animation.
Copy the generated CSS and HTML into your project.
keyFacts: A pure-CSS toggle switch is a styled checkbox — the knob moves using the input:checked + .track selector.
The track height is always 55 percent of the width, keeping the classic toggle proportion.
The knob slides with translateX, so the animation is GPU-accelerated and smooth.
A focus-visible outline is included so keyboard users can see the active switch.
The generated code has no dependencies and works in every modern browser.
css-switch-generator.keywords: css switch generator, css toggle switch, pure css toggle, on off switch css
limitations: The switch is a binary on/off control — it cannot represent a third indeterminate state without extra code.
Labels like On and Off next to the switch must be added in your own HTML.
Very old browsers without CSS transitions will flip the knob instantly instead of animating.
Right-to-left layouts need the knob travel direction mirrored manually.

css-switch-generator.quickAnswer: A toggle switch is the sliding on/off control you see in settings pages and dark-mode buttons. It is really just a styled checkbox: clicking it flips a hidden input, and a CSS :checked selector slides the knob and recolors the track. This tool generates that HTML and CSS for any width and brand color.
css-switch-generator.tagline: Generate pure-CSS toggle switches in any size and color — no JavaScript needed.
